name: Design Your Ad
description: Jointly generates personalized advertising images and text from multimodal user histories with a unified autoregressive model and introduces PAd1M and PBS (CVPR 2026).

name: Multi-Object Advertisement Creative Generation
description: Introduces CreativeAds for scalable multi-product lifestyle advertising through product pairing, layout generation, background generation, and human oversight.

name: InnoAds-Composer
description: Generates e-commerce product posters in a single stage with joint subject, glyph, and style conditioning (CVPR 2026).

name: AutoPP
description: Automates product-poster generation and CTR-oriented optimization using unified design generation and online-feedback preference learning (AAAI 2026).

name: RefAdGen
description: Generates high-fidelity advertising images while preserving referenced product identity through spatial mask control and product-feature fusion (AAAI 2026).

name: T-Stars-Poster
description: Provides an end-to-end product-centric advertising-design framework covering prompting, layout, background synthesis, and final rendering (CIKM 2025).
date_note: arXiv v1 precedes CIKM 2025, held November 10-14, 2025

name: Towards Reliable Advertising Image Generation Using Human Feedback
description: Uses a learned reliable-feedback network, recurrent generation, and feedback-guided diffusion fine-tuning to improve usable e-commerce advertising images (ECCV 2024).

name: E-comIQ-ZH
description: Evaluates Chinese e-commerce posters with expert-aligned multidimensional scores and chain-of-thought rationales through E-comIQ-18k and E-comIQ-Bench (CVPR 2026).

name: AutoPP1M
description: Provides one million product posters and online-feedback data for poster generation and CTR-oriented preference optimization.

name: AdProd-100K
description: Provides product images, advertising images, masks, and text descriptions for high-fidelity product-preserving advertising generation.

name: PITA
description: Provides 38,017 product-centric e-commerce advertising designs with product masks, foreground/background prompts, and graphic and nongraphic element layouts.
date_note: introduced with T-Stars-Poster arXiv v1; public Tianchi dataset

name: RF1M
description: Provides more than one million human-annotated generated advertising images labeled for availability and common product-background generation failures.
date_note: introduced with ECCV 2024 paper arXiv v1

name: PAd1M
description: Provides personalized advertising image-text examples and user-history conditioning for general and personalized advertisement generation; the test set and a training preview are public.
date_note: public with Design Your Ad release; full training set still uploading at checked date

name: PBS
description: Measures product-background similarity for evaluating advertising-image generation independently of text-generation metrics.

name: Qwen-Image EliGen Poster
description: Provides Qwen-Image LoRA weights specialized for e-commerce poster generation with precise region-mask control over poster entities.
date_note: public model release announced by DiffSynth-Studio
